# Zoo Labs Foundation

> Open AI research network for decentralized AI (DeAI) and decentralized science (DeSci).

## About
Zoo Labs Foundation (zoo.ngo) is an open AI research network advancing decentralized AI (DeAI) and decentralized science (DeSci). The foundation coordinates community-driven research, funds grants, publishes open-source AI tools, and governs its ecosystem through ZIPs (Zoo Improvement Proposals). Zoo operates at the intersection of frontier AI research and decentralized governance.

## Key Features
- Open AI research network with community governance
- ZIPs (Zoo Improvement Proposals) at zips.zoo.ngo
- Decentralized AI (DeAI) experiments and infrastructure
- Decentralized Science (DeSci) research initiatives
- Research grants and funding programs
- Open-source AI model releases
- Community-driven governance and voting
- Research paper publication and peer review
- Collaboration with academic and industry partners
- Bleeding-edge AI/science experimentation

## Ecosystem
- [Zoo Labs Foundation](https://zoo.ngo) - Main foundation site
- [ZIPs](https://zips.zoo.ngo) - Improvement proposals and governance
- [Zoo Lab](https://zoo.lab) - Research laboratory
- [Zoo Vote](https://zoo.vote) - Governance voting
